name: vault-ledger
description: Personal finance app with a double-entry ledger, automation rules, and Monte Carlo forecasting.

scripts.preview: npm run build:web -w @vault-ledger/mobile && npx tsx scripts/serve-dist.ts
scripts.db:up: node -e "const { execSync } = require('child_process'); try { execSync('docker compose up -d db', { stdio: 'inherit' }); } catch (e) { console.warn('Note: Docker DB container startup skipped (Docker daemon not running). Using mock demo mode.'); }"
scripts.dev: npm run db:up && concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @vault-ledger/api" "npm run web -w @vault-ledger/mobile"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @vault-ledger/api && npm run build:web -w @vault-ledger/mobile
